name: 36596-decodeburst-35ba3b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=800, bounded at 800 requests with a 600 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown; streams == max_requests, so all 800 fire at once and none are resubmitted.
workload: SYNTHETIC, 800 requests, every prompt exactly 128 tokens and every generation exactly 500 tokens, greedy (temperature 0), request_format plain, seed 36596.
purpose: A long-form content generator for 800 simultaneous users, short prompts and lengthy replies, on two GPUs.
launch:
# Engine: vLLM at 06e0bc21d2f978ef86ea7f98868922aecc524d26 (v0.17.1rc0-99-g06e0bc21d2f9).
# Keys from a later vLLM are not accepted by this engine's arg surface.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 2
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 32768
max-num-batched-tokens: 32768
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The declared burst is exactly 800; the engine's own default here would be 1024.
max-num-seqs: 800
